data.one_liner: Async fields with observable values, caching and stale handling for any data source
data.what_it_does: Provides a storage-backed field abstraction that can fetch, save and observe values asynchronously. Fields expose default values, fetchers, savers and change listeners, and support stale data handling and periodic refresh.
use_when: You need to fetch data from a remote API and keep it in sync with local storage
You want observable async values that notify listeners on change
You need a simple cache with stale‑value support without a full state‑management solution
avoid_when: You already use a full state‑management library like Riverpod or Bloc
You need complex dependency injection or navigation features
strengths: Supports multiple storage backends (DB, HTTP, isolates)
Built‑in change listeners and stale‑value handling
Null safety and modern Dart SDK compatibility
weaknesses: Limited to async field use‑cases, not a general state manager
No built‑in UI widgets or integration with Flutter widgets
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import package, create AsyncStorage and define fields
